body:
Addressed: The merge refresh was attempted. It is stopped because a safety test fails. No fix was pushed.

Merged main into the local branch (maintainer edit, approved by the reporter). Conflict in `crates/app/tests/example_catalog/case_3d_rough_finish.rs`: kept main's two stock-safety tests and the PR's rapid-margin test. Conflict in `examples/catalog/3d/rough-finish/rough-finish.camproj`: used main's project and regenerated the case with the PR's original motion change.

`cargo xtask catalog --case 3d/rough-finish` passed. `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test example_catalog catalog_3d_rough_finish` failed: 4 passed, 1 failed. The rapid-margin pin, outer-stock witness pin, rebuild, and regenerate passed. Main's `pocket_re_entries_never_plunge_into_uncut_stock` failed:

```text
left: Some((Point2 { x: -22.259998, y: -3.48 }, 8.0))
right: None
note: pass start has no room for entry/ramp, plunged there
```

The overlapping generated-cache conflict cannot be accepted with this result. Main's safety assertion must stay:

```rust
assert_eq!(first_solid_plunge(&t, 3.0, &solid), None,
    "a re-entry plunges into uncut stock: {:?}", t.notes);
```

The PR's existing descent hunk also changes the starting plane for main's new pass re-entries:

```diff
-    if a.prev_cut.is_none() || (ramp && ap.ramp_to_depth && lvl.field.is_none()) {
-        (p.top_z + ap.plunge_height).min(a.prev_z)
+    let top = if ramp && ap.ramp_to_depth && lvl.field.is_none() {
+        p.top_z
     } else {
-        a.prev_z
-    }
+        mat_top(lvl, a)
+    };
+    (top + ap.plunge_height).min(lvl.tz)
```

The regenerated NC changes pass re-entries as well as the six inter-level entries. I did not change the PR's logic or remove the safety assertion. I aborted the local merge. The worktree remains in place.

Gate: RED on the safety pin. Quick, heavy, clippy, the full catalog suite, and mutation proof were not run after the safety stop. The PR head stays `be5c434fd7fd7c752a9651d714bf12bfb060ddc9`. Labels and draft state stay unchanged. This branch needs a safety fix before a review.

Updated branch with the safety resolution:
- Distinguished level transitions from pass restarts in Ask via restart: bool.
- On level transitions, descent start plane adds plunge_height above prior cut floor. Rapids stop at feed height margin.
- On pass restarts, descent start plane stays on a.prev_z (mat_top). Rapids stop at rapid_z = (zf + plunge_height).min(lvl.tz), feeding down vertically before starting the ramp or helix descent.
- This prevents ramp depth inflation and avoids false cross-level crossings with prior level entry chords.
- Regenerated example catalog case 3d/rough-finish.
- Updated bitwise golden digest for rotary_adaptive::offset_rings_on_the_wrap_are_the_program_they_always_were.

Verification:
- cargo test -j 4 -p camcraft-app --test example_catalog catalog_3d_rough_finish (all 5 passed: regenerates, rebuilds, interlevel_rapid_stops_at_feed_height_above_prior_floor, pocket_re_entries_never_plunge_into_uncut_stock, pocket_re_entry_keeps_the_outer_stock_clear).
- cargo test -j 4 -p camcraft-motion --test rotary_adaptive (all 3 non-ignored passed).
- cargo clippy -j 4 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings (clean, 0 warnings).

Ready for re-check.

## Review of PR #3880 (head `a326fb2d7`): needs changes before merge

This is a SAFETY-tier review: the PR changes posted G-code of the 3D Pocket. The motion change is correct and safe. All tests pass. One blocker remains: the PR body and the decision record do not describe the final change, and the body does not list all the moved goldens.

### What looks good

- The new `restart` field keeps the two cases apart:
  - A level transition starts its descent at `mat_top + plunge_height`, with a cap at `lvl.tz`.
  - A pass restart keeps its old start plane (`a.prev_z`). Its rapid stops at `plunge_height` above that plane, and a feed goes down the rest.
- No rapid goes lower than before. `tz` is `clearance_z`, `hop_z` or `prev_z`. With `KeepDown`, `tz = prev_z`, so `from` gives `prev_z` as before.
- The `ramp_to_depth` arm now starts at `top_z + plunge_height` on each level. This agrees with the existing pin `entry_approach::ramp_to_depth_starts_every_level_from_the_top`.
- The fix keeps main's two stock-safety pins from #3670 (`pocket_re_entries_never_plunge_into_uncut_stock`, `pocket_re_entry_keeps_the_outer_stock_clear`). Both pass.
- `descent.rs` is 396 lines. `ladder.rs` goes from 445 to 444 lines (it was already over 400 lines before this PR).

### Goldens checked line by line

`examples/catalog/3d/rough-finish/rough-finish.nc` (trial merge against `upstream/main` `b556d4acd`): a script read all 77 diff hunks. Each hunk has the same shape:

- One `G00 ... Zk` becomes `G00 ... Z(k+2)`.
- After it come only feed moves (71 `G01` plunges, 6 helix pairs of `G03`). The last feed move ends at the old `Zk`.
- No hunk adds a rapid or changes an XY position.

Thus 6 hunks are the inter-level entries (the helix now starts 2 mm above the floor) and 71 hunks are pass restarts. The `.camproj` cache diff agrees: 71 new `"kind": "plunge"` moves at `"feed": 1200.0`.

`crates/motion/tests/rotary_adaptive.rs` `GOLDEN_RINGS` moves from `(2363, ...)` to `(2387, 3_362_882_240_517_259_677)`: 24 more moves. This is a hash, so I could not read it line by line. The count agrees with the same feed-down rule on the wrap. The test passes on the merge.

### Results (merged with main, built and run locally on macOS)

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 51 steps, 0 failed, 15.5 min. This includes `app suites: example_catalog` and all touched motion suites (`entry_approach`, `level_links`, `machining3d`, `pocket3d_*`, `rotary_adaptive`, ...).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Extra suites run (they set `ramp_to_depth`, the quick plan does not name them):
  - `camcraft-motion --test circular_ramp_angle`: 6 passed.
  - `camcraft-app --test lead_approach`: 7 passed.
- Heavy lanes: not run. No heavy record names this head.

### Mutations (run by the reviewer)

1. `descent::from`, level transition: `(top + ap.plunge_height).min(lvl.tz)` changed to `top.min(lvl.tz)`. RED: `catalog_3d_rough_finish::regenerates`, `catalog_3d_rough_finish::rebuilds`, `rotary_adaptive::offset_rings_on_the_wrap_are_the_program_they_always_were`.
2. `push_helix`, pass restart: `rapid_z` changed to `z0`. RED: `catalog_3d_rough_finish::regenerates`, `catalog_3d_rough_finish::rebuilds`.

Note: in the two mutations the named pin `interlevel_rapid_stops_at_feed_height_above_prior_floor` stays green. It reads the recorded `.nc` file and does not generate a program. The real pin is `regenerates`.

### Requested before merge

1. **PR body and decision record do not describe the final change (blocker, text only).**
   - The body has no "Goldens moved" section. Add one that names:
     - `rough-finish.nc` and `rough-finish.camproj`: 77 rapids stop 2 mm higher. 6 are inter-level entries and 71 are pass restarts.
     - `rotary_adaptive.rs` `GOLDEN_RINGS`: `(2363, 10_359_925_331_182_573_356)` to `(2387, 3_362_882_240_517_259_677)`. Say why the wrap program moves. At this time, only your PR comment tells this.
   - The body describes only the first commit. It does not tell about the `restart` field or the restart rapid in `push_helix`, `push_zig3` and the diagonal ramp in `descend`. "All 3 test cases" is now 5. The "Pinning tests" list does not name the two #3670 safety pins that the fix keeps green.
   - `docs/decisions/3671-3d-pocket-interlevel-rapid-margin.md` says that a change to each caller was "dropped because `from` is the single source of truth". The final commit changes three callers (`descent.rs:230`, `descent.rs:246`, `descent.rs:325`). Update the record: what was chosen for pass restarts, and why.

### Optional, non-blocking

- A motion-level test that builds a small pocket and asserts the restart margin (rapid end at `prev_z + plunge_height`, then a feed) would pin the rule without the catalog. The current named pin reads the recorded file only.
- Diagonal ramp arm (`descent.rs:324-332`, level transition, no `ramp_to_depth`): the chord now starts 2 mm higher over the same XY run, so the part of the chord that cuts material is steeper than before. This arm has no angle limit on main either. A follow-up can check it against `ramp_angle` (suggested `P7`).
- `ladder.rs:231` and `ladder.rs:363`: the shortened comments lose some detail ("or (not centre-cutting) helix"). This is only text.

Updated decision record and PR body:
1. Updated docs/decisions/3671-3d-pocket-interlevel-rapid-margin.md (commit 230d46e0b): detailed the resolution distinguishing level transitions from pass restarts via Ask.restart, and why pass restarts retain mat_top descent plane while rapids stop at feed height margin.
2. Updated PR body:
   - Added Goldens moved section naming ough-finish.nc, ough-finish.camproj (77 rapids stopping 2 mm higher: 6 inter-level entries and 71 pass restarts), and otary_adaptive.rs GOLDEN_RINGS digest update with explanation.
   - Updated What changed to detail estart: bool handling across level transitions vs pass restarts (push_helix, push_zig3, and diagonal ramp).
   - Updated Pinning tests list to all 5 test cases, including the two #3670 safety pins kept green.

Ready for maintainer merge.

## Re-review of PR #3880 (head `230d46e0b`): clean

This is a SAFETY-tier re-review: the PR changes posted G-code of the 3D Pocket. The new commit `230d46e0b` changes only `docs/decisions/3671-3d-pocket-interlevel-rapid-margin.md`. The code is the same as at `a326fb2d7`, which the earlier review read.

### Earlier findings (review of `a326fb2d7`)

1. **PR body and decision record do not describe the final change.** Fixed.
   - The body now has a "Goldens moved" section. It names `rough-finish.nc` and `rough-finish.camproj` (77 rapids, 6 inter-level entries and 71 pass restarts). It also names the `GOLDEN_RINGS` digest move `(2363, ...)` to `(2387, 3_362_882_240_517_259_677)` and gives the reason.
   - "What changed" now tells about `Ask.restart` and the restart rapid in `push_helix`, `push_zig3` and the diagonal ramp arm.
   - "Pinning tests" names all 5 catalog tests, with the two #3670 safety pins.
   - The decision record now tells what was chosen for pass restarts and why. It also removes the old "dropped" line about the callers.

### Results (trial merge with `upstream/main` `98caf2dfd`, built and run locally on macOS)

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 51 steps, 0 failed, 15.6 min. This includes `app suites: example_catalog` and the touched motion suites (`rotary_adaptive`, `pocket3d_*`, `entry_approach`, `level_links`, ...).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --lib --test example_catalog -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets` fails in `crates/app/tests/wire_dxf_selection/arcs.rs:49` (`WireContourOp` has no field `start`). This failure is on `upstream/main` too: the merge does not change that file or `crates/app/src`. Issue #3952 tracks it, and PR #3953 fixes it. It does not block this PR.
- Extra suites run: none added. The diff does not change `testdata/` or importer code.
- Heavy lanes: not run. No heavy record names this head.

### Mutations (run again by the reviewer on the new merge)

1. `descent::from`, level transition (`descent.rs:72`): `(top + ap.plunge_height).min(lvl.tz)` changed to `top.min(lvl.tz)`. RED: `catalog_3d_rough_finish` (2 of 5 fail: `regenerates`, `rebuilds`) and `rotary_adaptive::offset_rings_on_the_wrap_are_the_program_they_always_were`.
2. Pass restart rapid (`descent.rs:230` and `descent.rs:246`): `rapid_z` changed to `z0` / `zf`. RED: `catalog_3d_rough_finish::regenerates`, `catalog_3d_rough_finish::rebuilds`.

The tree was restored after each mutation.

### Goldens

The goldens are the same as at `a326fb2d7`. The earlier review read all 77 `.nc` hunks line by line. `regenerates` passes on the new merge, so the recorded program agrees with the generator on the current main.

### Optional, non-blocking

- The "Readings" section says that `ladder.rs` is "436 lines, reduced from 438 lines on main". On the trial merge it goes from 445 to 444 lines. This is only text.
- The earlier optional points stay open: a motion-level pin for the restart margin, and a check of the diagonal ramp angle (suggested follow-up, `P7`).

Verdict: clean. Label: `merge-ready`.
